brief:
Israeli forces opened fire with live ammunition during a settler assault near al-Mughayyir village in the occupied West Bank, wounding at least two Palestinians, Al Jazeera reported. The shooting took place as settlers conducted an attack in the area adjacent to Ramallah, a major Palestinian city.

The circumstances that prompted Israeli forces to discharge their weapons remained unclear. Specifics about how the two Palestinians were injured and their current medical condition were not immediately disclosed. Settler violence in the West Bank has intensified in recent months, often accompanied by Israeli military presence in the region.
